meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 它会把仓库里所有 open 的 issue 和 PR 逐条分析，每一项一个后台任务，产出带 GitHub permalink 证据的报告，写入 /tmp 的时间戳目录。全程只读：不评论、不合并、不关闭、不加标签。
howto.when: 当你提到 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等触发词时接管，开始只读分析全部待处理项。

say.text: triage 一下这个仓库的 issue
say.note: 每个 open issue 生成一份报告

say.text: triage PRs，看这个仓库的开放 PR
say.note: 每个 PR 一份带 permalink 的报告
只读分析，报告写进 /tmp 时间戳目录

howto.what_en: After you ask for triage, it analyzes every open issue and PR, one background task per item, and writes evidence-backed reports with GitHub permalinks to a timestamped /tmp folder. Read-only: no comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs" etc.; it then read-only analyzes all open items.

say_en.note: Writes one report per open issue
Read-only; reports go to a /tmp timestamped dir
